name: Kiro Pro Max

meters.label: Monthly credits
meters.hint: 5,000 credits. app.kiro.dev/account/usage, or the usage view in Kiro IDE or CLI.

reset.rule: Resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of each month.
stipulations: Each request costs a fraction of a credit, to 0.01, times the model's multiplier. Auto is 1x.
GPT-5.6 over 272K tokens costs double. Grok 4.7 over 200K costs 5.4x. Haiku 5.5 over 100K costs 0.3x.
Unused plan credits don't carry over.
Trial and add-on credits are spent after plan credits.
The usage figure updates at least every 5 minutes.

overage: At the limit, requests pause until the 1st unless you have trial or add-on credits. Add-on credits cost $0.04 each in packs of $5 to $100, up to 5 packs at once. They're charged when you buy them and last 12 months. There's no automatic overage.

how: 5,000 credits a month, reset on the 1st at 00:00 UTC.
Each request costs a fraction of a credit times the model's multiplier.
ext: Claude, GPT, Grok, Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax and Qwen models, each at its own multiplier.
Works in Kiro IDE, Kiro CLI, Kiro Web, IDEs that support ACP, and CI/CD. Routing it through other harnesses such as OpenClaw isn't allowed.
quirks: Your first upgrade from Free makes the rest of that month free and adds 500 trial credits that last 12 months.
Upgrades apply at once and are prorated to the second. Downgrades apply next month, and you pay the full current month.
Auto, DeepSeek 3.2, MiniMax M2.5, GLM-5 and Qwen3 Coder Next also work on the Free plan.

modelTable.title: Kiro: credit multipliers
modelTable.note: Auto is 1x. A model at 2x spends credits twice as fast as Auto for the same request.
modelTable.footer: Claude Fable 5.1 and 5.2 (6x) are Enterprise only.
